description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to latest LTS versions

tasks.description: Upgrade to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.4
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to 21, Spring Boot to 3.4, Spring Framework to 6.x, and migrate javax.* to jakarta.* namespace if needed. Update all related Spring dependencies (Spring Security, Spring Data, etc.) to versions compatible with Spring Boot 3.4. Ensure build tooling (Maven/Gradle) plugins are updated to support Java 21.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded Java from 17 to 21 and migrated javax.* to jakarta.* namespace. Updated service/pom.xml: compiler source/target to 21, javax.websocket to jakarta.websocket-client-api:2.2.0 and jakarta.websocket-api:2.2.0, javax.servlet-api to jakarta.servlet-api:6.1.0, Jetty plugin from jetty-maven-plugin:9.4.48 to jetty-ee10-maven-plugin:12.0.21, maven-surefire-plugin to 3.2.5. Updated client/pom.xml: Java 21, compiler plugin 3.13.0, surefire 3.2.5. Migrated NewsWebSocket.java and RabbitMQConsumer.java from javax to jakarta imports. Updated web.xml to Jakarta EE namespace. Build passed and unit tests passed.
